name: Ens. Red Shirt

design.ref_text: Hi there! Ensign reporting for duty! I'm so excited to be here. I already finished three tasks, and I'd love to do three more. Just point me at the next mission!

notes: Cheerful, eager, young; the only higher (female) voice in the cast, so it is clearly distinct from Barclay/Riker/Picard. The same voice plays every generation (#46, #47...). Full sentences only.
